column1: # Dual-slot OTA partition layout for HashCash NanoMiner V1 (8 MB flash).
# Two equal app slots enable A/B OTA updates with bootloader rollback per F-9.
# nvs is shared and persists across slot swaps (holds Settings + Policy struct per F-3).
# nvs_keys reserves space for HMAC eFuse-derived keys if needed in the future.
# spiffs is small; LilyMiner does not use a large filesystem.
